verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm Radeon docs list the RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) as a supported PyTorch/JAX target. The same Radeon docs state "vLLM: Full support" and "Llama.cpp: Supported for efficient inference," and AMD also has vLLM and SGLang setup guides, so the serving-stack half of the story is documented. However, the pack has no evidence on low-precision inference formats (FP8/FP4) for this part, and the vLLM/SGLang guides are generic AMD-GPU pages rather than 9070 XT-specific. Missing for 10: documented FP8/FP4 support for this part, part-specific serving-stack validation, independent or hands-on corroboration of LLM inference on the 9070 XT.
